facts.fact: Bethany Peters 回到 Austin，借住在最好的朋友 Lily 家的沙发上——和近十年前她十八岁初到 Austin 时一样。
facts.anchor: Since getting back into town, she’d been crashing on her best friend Lily’s couch, just like she’d done almost a decade earlier when she first arrived in Austin.

facts.fact: Lily 的 cis 妻子 Mona 起夜喂婴儿时撞见 Bethany 在 GlobalVill feed 上看视频（戴 ski mask 的男人与被切开的 deer carcass 上半身）；Bethany 解释 “I get paid to watch this”，Mona 挡住婴儿眼睛，Bethany 按下 admin panel 上的红键。
facts.anchor: “I get paid to watch this,” Bethany said, which was her attempt at an explanation. Mona shielded her baby’s eyes from the screen as Bethany clicked the red button on her admin panel.

facts.fact: 当晚 Lily 与 Mona 隔墙争执：Lily 说 Bethany 是她最老的朋友之一、想守着 T4T 情谊；Mona 回说她不在乎 T4T、在自己家里都不自在、认为婴儿待在 Bethany 身边不安全——Bethany 意识到被赶走迫在眉睫。
facts.anchor: “I don’t care about T4T. I don’t feel comfortable in my own home,” Mona said. “I don’t think my baby is safe around her.”

facts.fact: Bethany 自 Turbo Putt 那晚起一直在 GlobalVill.com 上搜 Jules Estrada，但 Jules 没发过任何新视频；另一位盟友 Kyle 也持续 MIA——过去一周她给他打过、发过无数次电话和短信。
facts.anchor: but Jules hadn’t posted any new videos. And Kyle, the only other person who felt like anything of an ally in the wreck that her life had become, was still MIA as well.

facts.fact: Bethany 打通了躲避已超过一个月的那通电话：收拾行李、没留字条离开 Lily 家，坐公交进城去见失联已久的男友 Abel 吃晚餐。
facts.anchor: She packed up her stuff and left Lily’s without writing a note, then caught the bus downtown to meet her long-lost boyfriend Abel for dinner.

facts.fact: 在四美元符号档位的法餐馆 La Paisible，Abel 转述警方来电（他的车报废停在 Lubbock 城外的拖车场，他对警方谎称车被偷过），并当面控诉 Bethany 偷车、失踪、让他拿着戒指跪在地上；他宣布 “I’m done being your doormat”。
facts.anchor: You stole my car. You disappeared. You left me kneeling on the ground with a ring in my hand.”

facts.fact: Bethany 道歉（说自己已戒酒、“I think I’m going to die”、保证辞职变好）并请求帮助；Abel 让步：“Of course I won’t give up on you”。
facts.anchor: “Of course I won’t give up on you,” he said. “I love you, Beth.”

facts.fact: Abel 突然抓胸痛倒、扯翻桌布和 Malbec 酒杯；Bethany 冲过去呼救，看见半秒灰色电视雪花闪过他的双眼后消退——有人拨打 911，但 Abel 已经死了。
facts.anchor: She looked back at Abel on the ground, and for half a second she saw a flicker of gray television static flare across his eyes. Then the static receded.
